sample_interval.description: The time interval between data samples in seconds. Can be a float.

output_file.description: Path to the file where topline's output should be redirected. Empty string means stdout.

linearize_output.description: Whether to marshall program output line-by-line, avoiding mix-ups with topline's graph data.

delay_dump.description: Whether to suppress graph output until the program exits, then dump the logged graph to stderr.

command.description: The program to run and monitor. If empty, topline logs system state indefinitely.

command_args.description: List of arguments to pass to the command being monitored.
